name: Short-Stay Visa / Visa-Free Entry (Schengen)

requirements.blocker_text: The C visa (Schengen short-stay visa) or visa-free entry is intended for stays of up to 90 days within any 180-day period.

Nationals of countries not covered by EU Regulation 2018/1806's visa-exemption list must obtain a Schengen short-stay (C) visa before travel; others may enter visa-free for the same 90/180-day allowance.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a C visa at a Belgian embassy/consulate if not visa-exempt.

sources.title: IBZ (Belgian Immigration Office / FPS Home Affairs) -- National Entries (Visa D): distinguishes the C visa (Schengen, up to 90 days) from the D visa (national long-stay)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Belgium). Standard Schengen 90/180-day short-stay framework; visa requirement is nationality-dependent per EU Regulation 2018/1806, modeled as a soft (hard:false) branch.
